sourceOriginChain.derivationNote: Issue #328: the MPFB2 materializer now derives its macro dict from the tracked Anny reference instead of baking the default human. age=0.15 from the measured head-height fraction (0.160, child band — the MPFB age macro has a real child band 0.0-0.1875, so this is a macro CHILD, not a scaled adult); height=0.569 SOLVED by bake-measure-interpolate so the baked+stripped exported body reaches the reference stature (1.25 m). Macros baked into the basis via TargetService.bake_targets immediately after create_human. #317 face keys (32 targets / 13 mouth), #318 helper strip (19,158->13,380 verts / 36,972->26,756 tris), #321 toigo t-shirt fit (2,700 tris, k-NN weighted to the standard rig) and #323 body-part hiding all ran unchanged. Measured (largest non-garment/non-hidden primitive): largestVisiblePrimitiveSpanM 1.1651 (NOT stature — the torso is hidden under the fitted shirt (#323), so this is a visible-skin span, not the body's height; the shipped body's stature is ~1.241 m), chest 0.6237, waist 0.7660, chest:waist ratio 0.8142. The toigo t-shirt was authored for an adult; its fit on the child is expected loose and was not re-graded. Regenerated 2026-08-11 (#337 resume): merged main (#335) and re-baked with CC0 MakeHuman default eyes (data/eyes/hm08/low-poly, header-verified CC0) fitted pre-#318-strip via HumanService.add_mhclo_asset(asset_type="eyes", material_type="PROCEDURAL_EYES"); eye mesh renamed makeclothes_library_eyes_low_poly_mpfb_<body>_mesh (96 verts / 172 tris), weighted 1.0 to eye.L/eye.R by interpolate_weights (dominant groups eye.L 48 / eye.R 48); #334 hide-mask head-joint bound and #335 casts preserved; iris rotation delta at gaze=1 measured 10-13 mm, 89-94% lateral. Issue #340: re-baked with the eye material consuming the asset's OWN declared .mhmat — brown.mhmat's diffuseTexture brown_eye.png (CC0, 610,817 bytes, git blob bda1b4b0 == upstream main) bound as glTF baseColorTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path; the flat eye baseColor (#337 white / #338 brown) is gone. Eye geometry (96 verts / 172 tris, eye.L/eye.R weights) unchanged; body macros, hide masks, garment fits, footwear and sole grounding re-run identically. textureMode updated procedural_fallback -> authored_or_baked because the eye channel now carries a baked diffuse texture. Issue #180 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the #180 palette + scrub wiring — materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now takes --actor-role and consumes automate_blender.garment_shell_color as-is (locked gown/scrub + closed_casual role fallback; no table copied). Nurse actor: upper garment is the CC-BY makehuman-community-scrub-shirt Scrub_Shirt.mhclo (max ref 11,018 < 13,380, fits the #318 stripped basemesh; ClothesService smoke fit ok, 4,688 verts / 9,384 tris) with the locked scrub colour (0.05, 0.48, 0.52); patient actors keep the CC0 toigo t-shirt with the closed_casual role palette (patient 0.72, 0.68, 0.55; family/parent 0.42, 0.36, 0.40); lower follows the same palette call. Post-fix the peds cast is pairwise distinct on upper AND lower base colours and the clinician's upper asset differs from the patients'. Footwear assets unchanged. Encounter-distance legibility is graded from the staged lit capture by the orchestrator. Issue #356 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the iris colour case-driven like the garment slot (#180). Pre-fix measured (mpfb-eye-colour/pre-fix.json): one byte-identical iris across the cast (sha256 4659691c7295ad62, 610,817 bytes, 1024^2 RGBA, factor (1,1,1)); baked brown, not greyscale (37% chromatic pixels, hue 34 deg). A licence-clear second asset exists: the official makehuman_system_assets CC0 pack (9 iris colours; every <colour>.mhmat carries the same in-file CC0 header as hm08; pack brown_eye.png byte-identical to the shipped iris; recorded in third-party-asset-licence-ledger.md). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now consumes automate_blender.eye_iris_colour(actor_role, phenotype) and resolves the declared colour id to its staged <colour>.mhmat in .openclinxr-local/provider-cache/eyes/makehuman-system-assets/ via the unchanged generic make_material_from_mhmat path (no table copied, no colour invented; baseColorFactor stays (1,1,1) — the texture is the whole appearance). This actor's iris: brown (byte-identical to pre-fix). Issue #360 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the garment-texture wiring — the materializer now consumes each garment's OWN declared .mhmat diffuseTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path (the #340/#356 eye path): patients' upper toigo t-shirt consumes T-shirt_basic.png and each footwear slot consumes its declared map (flats Shoe.png / mj MJ-shoes3.png / boots boot.png). The #180 role colour is preserved as the exported baseColorFactor (glTF factor x texture; the exporter drops the factor when a texture binds, so it is patched into the GLB post-export). Recorded skips keep flat colours: the scrub's declared Scrub_Shirt.mhmat and the cargo-pants' cargo_pants.mhmat are not staged in the provider cache, and the shipped lower cover shell carries no TEXCOORD_0 — a lower-garment texture is a fitting-pipeline slice, not this material slice. Issue #359 (2026-08-13): re-baked after the #360 merge with the scalp region as the shipped hair mechanism — the body mesh carries the bounds-derived openclinxr_mesh_native_scalp_hair_surface primitive (the Anny known-good mechanism; the #341 texture-mask hairline route is removed because the #358 head-framed comparison graded it as damage and it painted the front face band). Region per actor: aisha 2,364 tris (0.894-1.000 H), nurse 2,400 (0.898-1.000 H), child 2,008 (0.898-1.000 H); zero face-band vertices on all three. Garment textures from #360 are unchanged by this bake. Issue #343 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the shipped subsurface tint — apply_subsurface_tint loads MPFB2's data/textures/sss.png (CC0) and combines it with the DIFFUSE COLOR bake as a relative warm brightening (no light transport, no hand-authored node graph — the #343 RETRY approach 2). Skin atlas block-mean (16x16) luminance sd 2.48 -> 3.86 (this actor); dark-texel counterweight (0.35x median) clean; per-actor atlases stay byte-distinct. Issue #370 (2026-08-13): re-baked with a tangent-space normal map. bake_skin_normal_to_texture bakes the shipped enhanced_skin shader's perturbed surface normal (the Noise Texture -> ColorRamp -> Bump feeding the Principled Normal) to a glTF normalTexture via a Cycles NORMAL bake (geometry + bump, not light transport) and wires it through a Normal Map node. The base-colour atlas is byte-identical to the #343 bake; iris (#356) and garment (#360) textures unchanged. Issue #372 (2026-08-13): re-baked after the #371 merge with the garment-texture restored — the #371 worktree lacked the t-shirt's staged .mhmat so the bake silently skipped the authored texture; this bake consumes T-shirt_basic.png (861,166 B, byte-identical to pre-#371) and the post-export texture verify + garments-keep-their-authored-texture.test.ts pin it from now on.

Issue #351 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the wrist/metacarpal limb vocabulary fix in body_param_stage._LIMB_BONE_RE (no-op on the mixamo_unity rail, which has neither bone). The lower cover shell's band selection wrapped the exported A-pose hands — this body's palms are metacarpal-dominant (120+120 outlying verts at |x| up to 0.382 m in the trouser top band) and the regex missed the MPFB standard rig's wrist/metacarpal bones — so the trousers shipped on the hands. Issue #372 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the garment-texture fix. The #371 rebake ran with an incomplete provider cache (the toigo t-shirt's declared t_shirt_basic_tucked.mhmat and its diffuse T-shirt_basic.png were not staged in that worktree), so garment_material_from_declared silently skipped the slot and the shipped GLB lost the t-shirt baseColorTexture — the shirt and trousers shared one factor and read as a onesie. This bake runs with the full staged cache: the t-shirt consumes T-shirt_basic.png (861,166 B — byte-identical to the pre-#371 embedded texture) as baseColorTexture, the #180 role colour stays the exported baseColorFactor, and the #371 auto-smooth pass is unchanged (garments-are-flat-shaded-and-the-body-is-not still green; 0 coplanar splits kept, sharp joins preserved). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now fails the bake loudly if a consumed garment texture is absent from the exported bytes (verify_garment_textures_in_glb), and the new evidence contract garments-keep-their-authored-texture.test.ts pins the authored state with kevin as the flat-by-authored-state known-good. Actor role unchanged (patient).

Issue #377 (2026-08-13): re-baked with anatomically sized eyeballs. The fitted CC0 eye was 25-34% larger than human ocular axial length (fitted 29.72 mm vs 22.5 mm, least-squares sphere fit). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now shrinks each eye to the actor's anatomical target AND re-seats it forward (scale about the fitted sphere centre + translate so the corneal pole keeps its world z) — the naive shrink alone recedes the pole 3.0-4.0 mm and hollows the eyes. MPFB has no eye-size parameter to wire (set_scalings is a no-op), so this is a post-fit transform in the materializer. The eye.L/eye.R bones move with the globe so the gaze pivot stays at the new centre. The child's 22.5 mm target was checked against its phenotype (height_cm 125, school-age) and confirmed. Clauses of the eyeballs contract: diameter <= 1.15x anatomy (flipped to it), corneal pole within 1 mm of its previous forward z, sphere fit residual within 3x its own baseline.

Issue #399 (2026-08-14): re-baked with the fitted hair — the child is the last MPFB actor on the placeholder scalp paint, and her fix is the MADR 0052 P3 advancement hour (#199 fitted the first garment; this is that hour). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now maps peds_patient_child to toigo_curled_under_bob_with_bangs (CC0 by its own .mhclo header, zero helper-vertex refs) through the SAME ClothesService.fit_clothes_to_human path #381 proved on aisha — the fit runs BEFORE the #318 helper strip, the hair OBJ file name is read from the .mhclo own obj_file header, and the bake re-reads the licence via read_hair_mhclo_licence (hard refusal on AGPL/unspecified). The child placeholder scalp paint is retired via body_param_stage.scalp_placeholder_retired_for (her real fitted hair is on disk), so the 2.8%-luminance paint is gone and the vacated polygons render as skin. Style chosen distinct from the parent aisha toigo_blunt_bob_with_bangs because the two stand together in peds_asthma_parent_anxiety_v1. Kevin (peds_nurse_kevin) keeps the RECORDED MALE LICENCE SKIP — every licence-clean style in the usable makehuman-hair01 subset is a feminine bob. Measured post-bake: placeholder scalp verts 0 (was 1,234), fitted hair 4,976 tris weighted to the standard rig head bone, style toigo_curled_under_bob_with_bangs, head skin verts 3,103; t-shirt T-shirt_basic.png and footwear MJ-shoes3.png textures consumed identically to the shipped bytes; cargo-pants recorded skip unchanged.
